summary: Iterates the linked list of animation channel nodes whose head is read through the pointer stored at this+0x110 (effective head address this+0x138). For each node, loads the channel-data pointer stored at node+0x54; when the flags dword at channel+0x18 has bit 0x400 set, adds argument a2 to the float accumulator at channel+0x38. Advances through the next pointer at node+0x5C. Returns the list traversal terminator (0 when the head is null).

Test the channel flags dword at v3+0x18 for bit 0x400; only flagged channels have the float applied.
Add a2 to the float accumulator at v3+0x38: *(float*)(v3+56) = a2 + *(float*)(v3+56).
Return the result of the list traversal (the null terminator; 0 when the head is null).
